jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: A Driver- CDL (B) is responsible for safely operating a collection truck, and providing prompt, courteous and complete waste removal services for customers. In addition, a Driver – CDL (B) is responsible for ensuring his or her vehicle is in compliance with the Company’s safety standards prior to operating the vehicle, ensures that all Company, state and federal regulations are adhered to at all times while operating the vehicle, and completes vehicle condition reports (“VCRs”) on a daily basis to ensure that any vehicle defects are repaired in a timely manner. PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES: Perform complete pre- and post-operation inspection of the vehicle in accordance with Company policy to ensure tire pressure, fluid levels, safety equipment, gauges, and controls are in proper working order. Report any safety issues on standard reports. Safely operate his or her heavy truck along his or her designated route and to the disposal site; read route sheet, follow map and service each customer as identified on the route sheet or as assigned by the dispatcher and/or supervisor. Operate manual and/or automatic controls in accordance with Company safety policies and procedures to lift and load refuse, operate compactor and dispose of collected material at the designated facility. Courteously interact with all customers, dispatchers and others on a daily basis to ensure all customer routes are serviced in a timely and professional manner. Identify unsatisfactory waste containers and tag containers in accordance with applicable departmental procedures. Continuously monitor waste for evidence of unacceptable waste. Clean area around an accidental waste spill, ensuring adherence to all applicable safety standards and policies. Continuously monitor the condition of the vehicle to ensure it is operationally ready at all times to minimize down time; clean waste from the packer blade and truck body (where appropriate) on each disposal trip. Complete required route/productivity sheets, VCRs and other reports, as required. Maintain adherence to required productivity standards for the department to ensure all customers are serviced in a timely and efficient manner. Follow all required safety policies and procedures. Actively participate in the Company’s ReSOP program. Perform other job-related duties as assigned. Good customer services skills to meet and exceed customer expectations; acts in a professional, courteous and cooperative manner toward customers and co-workers; works with a sense of honesty and trustworthiness. Good time management skills to ensure assigned responsibilities are completed in an efficient and safe manner. Good follow through ability; adheres to work schedule and follows through on challenges as they arise. Ability to adhere to Company policies and rules set forth; promotes the Company’s safety standards; does not take inappropriate risks. Maintains a feeling of pride in work; strives to achieve all goals. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: Class B or higher Commercial Driver’s license with air brakes endorsement. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the Company. EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4. ABOUT THE COMPANY Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills. Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it. Our company values guide our daily actions: Safe : We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities. Committed to Serve : We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations. Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment. Driven : We deliver results in the right way. Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person. We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods. STRATEGY Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets. We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation. With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. Recycling and Waste We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs. Environmental Solutions Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need. Sustainability Innovation Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth. The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America. Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year). ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Istanbul-based.

TEAM

You will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising Puzzle game in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

ROLE

As a Product Manager for one of our Puzzle Studio, you will be at the heart of the game's evolution. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, artists, and product experts to design, test, and refine features that keep our players engaged and entertained.

- Participate in the design and creation of engaging, challenging, and fun levels that maintain player interest and progression

- Develop and iterate on game mechanics and features that enhance the core gameplay loop

- Analyze player behavior, game metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement

- Collaborate with engineers and artists to bring level designs and features to life

- Structure, run, and monitor A/B tests to validate design decisions and optimize player experience

- Balance game difficulty curves to ensure appropriate challenge and retention across all levels

- Stay up-to-date with the hybrid-casual and puzzle game market, analyzing competitor games and emerging trends

- Test and playtest levels and features to ensure quality and enjoyment

- Contribute to the product roadmap and strategic direction

- Work iteratively, rapidly prototyping ideas and incorporating feedback from the team and data

PROFILE

- 2+ years of professional experience in game design, product specialist, or similar role in the mobile gaming industry

- Strong passion for mobile puzzle and hybrid-casual games, with a deep understanding of what makes them engaging and successful

- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven design decisions

- Understanding of player psychology and what drives engagement, retention, and satisfaction in puzzle games

- Strong communication skills and ability to clearly articulate design ideas to cross-functional teams

- Iterative mindset with the ability to rapidly test, learn, and improve designs based on feedback

- Fluent in English

- Bonus: Experience with Unity or game development tools, knowledge of A/B testing methodologies, experience shipping successful mobile games

BENEFITS:

- Best in Class compensation

- Other benefits according to the country you reside.

About the Role

OpenAI’s Applications organization spans rapidly growing Consumer, Enterprise, Developer, and Hardware businesses. As we scale across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM, we’re building the financial and operating model that will help our regional teams make faster, better decisions.

We are hiring a senior Strategic Finance partner to help shape that work. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to regional GMs, connecting market strategy with business performance and guiding where and how we invest. By bringing together insights across growth, revenue, OpEx, headcount, and marketing effectiveness, you’ll help leaders understand market health, set priorities, and drive measurable outcomes.

You’ll create the frameworks, operating rhythms, and decision processes needed to scale our international business, while contributing to broader Strategic Finance priorities across Marketing.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Periodic international travel is expected.

In this role, you will:

- Own an integrated view of OpenAI’s international performance—spanning countries, regions, and Consumer, Enterprise/API, and Developer businesses—to guide growth, resource allocation, and investment decisions.

- Partner with regional GMs and functional leaders to shape country strategies spanning Product, Sales, Growth and Brand Marketing, Partnerships, Communications, and Policy.

- Lead regional financial planning and forecasting, tracking budgets, headcount, capacity, investments, and risks against the company plan.

- Build and operationalize investment frameworks across markets, channels, and programs, evaluating expected returns, opportunity costs, and tradeoffs to recommend what to fund and when.

- Create regional and country scorecards and lead regular business reviews that track key metrics, surface risks, drive decisions, and ensure follow-through.

- Design decision rights and escalation paths across a cross-functional, matrixed organization so regional leaders can move quickly and major cross-market decisions receive appropriate review.

- Partner with Marketing, Growth, and Data Science to strengthen acquisition and retention measurement and translate results into executive-ready recommendations.

- Build scalable, AI-enabled workflows that improve reporting, forecasting, and investment evaluation across regions.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 10+ years of progressive experience across Strategic Finance, investment banking, consulting, private equity, or related operating roles.

- 2+ years of Strategic Finance experience at a high-growth technology company, including meaningful partnership with international, Marketing, Growth, or GTM teams.

- Exceptional financial modeling and analytical skills, with experience managing complex budgets and translating market economics, investment tradeoffs, and performance data into decisions.

- A track record of serving as a trusted thought partner to executives and cross-functional leaders.

- Fluency across Consumer and B2B business models, international market dynamics, and Growth, Brand, or go-to-market investment.

- Experience designing planning processes, operating cadences, scorecards, or investment frameworks that create clear ownership and produce measurable business outcomes.

- High agency, sound judgment, and comfort building structure in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

- Enthusiasm for AI and experience partnering with Data Science; SQL familiarity is a plus.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Your primary responsibility will be to develop engineering solutions that quantitatively enforce our marketplace policies.

Rather than building systems from scratch, you will expand upon our established validation frameworks to detect avatar schema compliance, flag geometry-based exploits, and programmatically measure asset quality. • Cross-Functional Execution: Work across the avatar stack, collaborating with engineers, product owners, and artists to translate complex marketplace policy requirements into clean, scalable code updates.

• Foundational knowledge of rendering pipelines.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Assistant Vice President (AVP), Business Intelligence & Analytics will be a hands-on leader responsible for delivering business intelligence, reporting, and analytics solutions across Human Capital. The role will work directly with stakeholders to understand business needs, execute one-off analyses, develop scalable self-service reporting, and lead a varied portfolio of analytics projects.

The AVP will also own the intake process for BI and analytics requests, including its ongoing modernization and day-to-day execution. The role will establish a clear and reliable way for work to enter the team, assess and clarify requests, support prioritization decisions, provide visibility into demand and capacity, and identify opportunities to reduce recurring manual work through automation and self-service solutions.

The AVP will independently own work from initial problem definition through requirements gathering, analysis, development, validation, communication, and implementation. The role will partner closely with the Head of People BI Analytics, other members of People Analytics, Human Capital stakeholders, Data Engineering, and Technology teams.

Over time, this role may grow to lead a small team of junior analysts focused primarily on Tier 1 service delivery (routine reporting tickets and recurring requests), with the AVP setting standards, reviewing quality, and developing the team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Intake & demand management

• Own and continuously improve the intake process for BI, reporting, and analytics requests - including submission, clarification, categorization, triage, tracking, and stakeholder communication.
• Develop practical frameworks for assessing urgency, business value, effort, sensitivity, and dependencies; partner with the Head of People BI & Analytics on major prioritization and capacity tradeoffs.
• Maintain visibility into request volumes, backlog, turnaround times, recurring demand, and available capacity; surface bottlenecks and propose remedies.
• Identify recurring or manual requests that should be automated, standardized, or converted into self-service solutions.

Analytics & reporting delivery

• Execute routine reporting requests and analytical requests end-to-end - from stakeholder discussion through requirements, analysis, validation, and delivery.
• Translate ambiguous business questions into clear requirements, analytical approaches, and reporting outputs.
• Query, combine, and analyze using SQL and other analytical tools.
• Design, develop, and maintain intuitive self-service dashboards using Tableau or comparable enterprise BI platforms.
• Lead defined analytics projects across workforce, organizational, recruiting, talent, performance, and survey domains.
• Synthesize findings into clear implications and practical recommendations for business stakeholders.

Partnership & product contribution

• Contribute to the design and enhancement of People Analytics datasets, dashboards, and reporting products.
• Partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to define data requirements, resolve dependencies, and investigate source-data, modeling, and quality issues.
• Document business logic, data sources, definitions, calculations, assumptions, and known limitations.
• Build trusted stakeholder relationships and communicate progress, findings, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.

Team leadership (future scope)

• Potential to build and lead a small team of junior analysts responsible for Tier 1 service delivery - routine reporting tickets, recurring requests, and standardized outputs.
• Define intake routing between Tier 1 (routine) and higher-tier (complex/bespoke) work, and set quality, turnaround, and documentation standards for Tier 1 delivery.
• Coach and develop junior analysts, review their work, and create a path for them to take on progressively more complex analyses over time.
• Balance hands-on delivery of complex work with oversight of the team's routine throughput.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience delivering business intelligence, reporting, or analytics solutions in a business or enterprise setting.
• Demonstrated experience independently owning complex reporting, dashboard, or analytics work end-to-end - from scoping and requirements through validation and delivery.
• Strong SQL skills, including querying, combining, and validating data across multiple structured sources.
• Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or a comparable enterprise BI platform.
• Experience translating ambiguous business questions into clear requirements, analytical approaches, and reporting outputs.
• Experience designing or improving intake, triage, or demand-management processes for a high-volume analytics or reporting function.
• Sufficient technical fluency to reason about data models, warehouses, reporting layers, and engineering dependencies, and to partner effectively with Data Engineering.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear findings and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience mentoring, coaching, or reviewing the work of junior analysts; direct people-management experience a plus but not required.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in People Analytics, Human Capital, HR technology, or workforce reporting.
• Familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, or comparable modern data and analytics platforms.
• Experience with modern data application/BI tools (e.g. Sigma, Streamlit)
• Experience partnering with a centralized or separately managed Data Engineering function.
• Experience operating in a complex, highly regulated, or data-sensitive environment (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
• Familiarity with data access, privacy, security, and governance requirements applicable to people data.

jobs.description: Become a part of our caring community Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first.We are seeking a skilled Decision Intelligence Engineer to design, train, and continuously improve the reinforcement learning policy at the heart of Humana's Next Best Action platform. In this role you will own the full RL development lifecycle from feature engineering and reward design through distributed training, evaluation, and production deployment ensuring that every decision the platform makes for our 8 million members is informed by a policy that learns and improves with every interaction. You will work at the intersection of healthcare outcomes and decision engineering, translating member journey data into durable, explainable, and auditable decisioning intelligence. This role is hands-on and research-oriented: you will implement and evaluate RL algorithms, instrument training pipelines, collaborate closely with data and platform engineers, and ensure the model operates correctly within the constraints of clinical eligibility rules and program-specific reward structures. Key Responsibilities Reinforcement Learning Model Development Design, implement, and evaluate RL algorithms suited to long-horizon, sparse-reward healthcare decisioning, including policy gradient methods (PPO, A3C), value-based approaches (DQN, Q-learning), and offline RL methods (CQL, Decision Transformer). Define and maintain the member state representation and action space, evolving both as new programs and data sources are onboarded. Apply the Bellman equation, reward shaping, and constraint mapping to encode clinical eligibility, suppression rules, and program-specific objectives directly into the learning objective. Manage exploration-exploitation tradeoffs appropriate for a production healthcare environment where poorly explored actions have real member impact. Model Evaluation and Production Safety Build simulation and backtesting environments to evaluate policy quality before production promotion, using historical member journey data. Diagnose and remediate common RL failure modes: policy collapse, credit assignment errors across long member journeys, and distributional shift between training and serving populations. Define reward threshold criteria and automated evaluation gates within the nightly Databricks training workflow; block promotion of underperforming policies to MLflow production. Instrument training runs with MLflow tracking hyperparameters, reward curves, action distribution, and feature importance for every training cycle. Training Pipeline Engineering Own the nightly Databricks training workflow: feature engineering from Gold Activity History and Gold Patient Profile, state vector normalization, distributed RL training via Ray RLlib, and batch scoring of all 8M eligible members. jobs.description: Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through one of the world’s largest and most diverse customer service workforces. As AI fundamentally changes how customer service work is performed, it also creates an opportunity to reinvent how associates learn, develop their capabilities, receive coaching, and continuously improve. The Associate Development team is building the next generation of learning, coaching and performance experiences for Amazon Customer Service Associates. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build these systems from the ground up. This is a highly greenfield opportunity. Rather than digitizing traditional training and coaching processes, we are rethinking how associate development should work in an AI-native world. What does an associate need to learn before doing a job? What can they learn through experience? What should AI provide in the flow of work? How can we understand an associate’s evolving capabilities and use that understanding to personalize development? How can generative AI help provide timely, relevant and effective coaching at the scale of a global workforce? Imagine systems that continuously learn from an associate’s experience and outcomes, identify where they would benefit from development, and deliver personalized learning or AI-powered coaching. The outcomes of those interventions can then become new evidence about the associate, creating a closed loop that gets smarter over time. As an SDE on this team, you will help define and build the technical foundations that make this possible. You will work on problems spanning generative AI, personalization, intelligent recommendations, learning and coaching systems, experimentation, data and distributed systems. You will have the opportunity to influence architecture at an early stage rather than inherit a predetermined technical solution. You will partner closely with Product, Science, UX and engineering teams across Amazon to turn ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. The systems you build have the potential to shape how Customer Service Associates around the world develop and succeed at work. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys zero-to-one problems, emerging AI technologies, large-scale systems and building products with direct human impact. Key job responsibilities - Design and build scalable services and experiences that power personalized learning, coaching and associate development across Amazon Customer Service. - Build AI-powered coaching capabilities, including applications of generative AI that can understand context, generate relevant guidance and adapt experiences to individual associate needs. - Develop systems that connect signals about associate capability and performance with the right development intervention at the right time. - Help create closed-loop systems that measure the outcomes of learning and coaching interventions and use that evidence to continuously improve future recommendations. - Work with Product and Science partners to translate emerging models and experimentation into reliable production systems. - Make foundational architectural decisions for a greenfield product space while determining where existing Amazon capabilities can be reused or evolved. - Design APIs, data models and integration patterns that allow Associate Development capabilities to interact with associate context, workflow and other Customer Service systems. - Build mechanisms for experimentation, measurement and observability so we can understand whether the experiences we create actually improve associate and customer outcomes. - Deliver secure, reliable and globally scalable systems while maintaining a high bar for operational excellence. A day in the life You might start the day working with a scientist on how an AI coaching experience can use an associate’s recent performance context to generate more useful coaching. Later, you could whiteboard an architecture for measuring whether that coaching actually changed future performance, review an API contract with another CS platform team, and prototype a new generative-AI capability. Because the space is early, you won’t simply be executing against a fully specified roadmap. You will help answer fundamental technical questions, prototype alternatives, make architecture decisions, and turn successful experiments into production systems capable of serving associates globally. About the team The Associate Experience (AE) team is building the future of work for Amazon Customer Service Associates. Our vision is to create a trusted Customer Service experience by enabling associates to succeed as the role evolves toward complex and non-deterministic problem solving. Within AE, the Associate Development team is reinventing how associates learn, develop and improve, moving beyond one-size-fits-all training and coaching towards, personalized development powered by AI. Engineers joining the team will shape foundational architecture, drive technology choices, and build AI-powered products from the ground up for one of the world's largest customer service workforces.

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities

• Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
• Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
• Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
• Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
• Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
• Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
• The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

TL;DR - Lovable is hiring a Community Manager, Virtual Spaces to own our virtual programs: the webinars, live builds, office hours, virtual buildathons, and microcommunities that reach our global community each week.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- 6+ years across virtual events, community programming, education, or developer relations, including time running a recurring live program that people showed up for week after week

- You've built and run a virtual program end-to-end inside an early stage or high-growth tech company: format, calendar, hosts, production, and follow-up

- A confident live host and facilitator: comfortable on camera, quick on your feet in Q&A, and able to make a session with 30 people feel as good as one with 500

- You've organized something with a start line and a finish line, like a hackathon, buildathon, cohort, or challenge, and know how to keep participants engaged through the middle

- Experience recruiting and coaching hosts and speakers, and turning enthusiastic community members into people who can run a session themselves

- Strong operator with production rigor: hosts booked, assets shipped, calendars accurate, recordings published, every week, without being chased

- Fluent in the tooling: Zoom, StreamYard, Luma or similar, and a video editing workflow you trust

- Builder instincts: you've shipped something yourself, or you're obsessed with people who do

- Comfortable coordinating across time zones and markets (US, Brazil, Europe)

What you’ll do

RUN THE VIRTUAL PROGRAM ENGINE

- Own Lovable's live virtual sessions across educational webinars, live builds, office hours, and persona-based series mapped to the ideate → build → run → grow journey

- Book hosts (Lovable team, PMM, execs, external experts, and community leaders), write event descriptions, coordinate assets, manage the calendar, and run the details for every session

- Own the recording pipeline: each session is captured, edited, and published to the Community Hub replay library so the content compounds

- Recruit and coach great hosts across the company and community, and develop community-led sessions so the program scales beyond what you can host alone

DESIGN AND RUN VIRTUAL BUILDATHONS

- Plan and execute virtual buildathons and challenges: theme, format, timeline, judging, prizes, kickoff and demo-day sessions, and everything in between

- Keep participants moving through the middle of a build, with check-ins, office hours, and peer support

- Partner with product, PMM, and partnerships to tie each buildathon to a launch, an audience, or a market

EXPERIMENT WITH MICROCOMMUNITIES

- Stand up and support smaller, focused groups inside the wider community: by persona (founders, marketers, ops), by region (US, Brazil, Europe), or by use case

- Give each microcommunity a rhythm of its own, with recurring sessions, a place to gather, and a leader who owns it

CLOSE THE LOOP

- Surface what you hear in sessions, from Q&A, chat, and follow-ups, to product, PMM, and marketing on a regular cadence

- Own the quality of the community CRM pipeline: registration data (persona, city, contact) that feeds broader campaigns, growth content, and enterprise marketing

- Track and report on program health: attendance, RSVP-to-attendance rate, post-event NPS, replay views, buildathon participation and completion, and microcommunity retention

- Celebrate community wins loudly: when someone ships something great in a session or buildathon, make sure the whole community (and company) knows

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.
